name: Patrick Schofield
title: Founder & Co-Founder
bio:
Patrick believes successful entrepreneurship is where impact and profit meet. He works with organisations across Africa on crowdsourcing, social funding, and the role technology can play in mobilising support for ideas, causes, and communities.

He began with Streetwires, creating work for skilled crafters without formal qualifications. In 2013, he co-founded Thundafund, South Africa’s leading rewards-based crowdfunding platform. In 2015, he re-launched BackaBuddy and founded the BackaBuddy Foundation, and has since grown BackaBuddy into Africa’s leading donations platform, enabling over 850 000 donors to find their purpose and 125 000 beneficiaries to be funded. Over R1 Billion has flowed.
